params.description: Allows you to return profit and losses that will be made from on or after a defined date/time. ISO 8601 standard.

params.name: event_date_time_to
params.description: Allows you to return profit and losses that will be made from on or before a defined date/time. ISO 8601 standard.

params.name: amount_from
params.description: Allows you to return profit and losses based on a minimum profit or loss amount.

params.name: amount_to
params.description: Allows you to return profit and losses based on a maximum profit or loss amount.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency of the profit and loss. ISO 4217 standard.

params.name: scope
params.description:
Scope allows contacts to search all profit and losses at all account levels. Defaults to own.
'own' - search profit and losses on the main account
'clients' - search profit and losses of account sub-accounts
'all' - search profit and losses of main account and sub-accounts.

params.name: page
params.description: Returns a specific page within the results of a search.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of entries to return per page of results.

params.name: order
params.description: The field to order entries by.

params.name: order_asc_desc
params.description: Whether the order is ascending (asc) or descending (desc).
